description: The app's own face, local content, and the only window label with any IPC. The workspace face is remote content and gets none at all: its only channel into the app is the intentic:// navigation the window handler intercepts — the title bar it draws for its own frameless window included. `set-title` is here because this one window has two screens and its title says which is up (App.vue), which is also the only thing outside the process that can tell them apart. `start-dragging` is what lets the card be moved by its own header, there being no title bar to drag it by (windows.rs).
